summary:
FIRST trustworthy, non-degenerate competence signal. Non-recoverable probes (rationale/findings/conventions) + controls, honest harness: guard trustworthy=true. cold 10/11 (controls 4/4, project 6/7=0.857), kb 11/11, kb_earned_project=1/7=14%. The one win (proj-net-metric-artifact): cold mis-stated the DIRECTION of a benchmark metric flaw; KB retrieved the recorded conclusion (cache_read mis-bucketing) and was right. CAVEAT: cold still had repo access (it cited exact 232-vs-230 diffTokens and named all 5 escalation conditions), so it got 6/7 anyway — 14% is a FLOOR measured in KB's hardest case. Sharpened thesis: onboarding-KB value is NOT 'knows the code' (agent reads code) but 'remembers hard-won analytical conclusions/rationale the code doesn't show'. The learning loop /11 is now justified, scoped to that non-recoverable band; running it doubles as the ceiling measurement (does kb_earned climb past 14% as the KB deepens?).</summary>
</invoke>
